rationale: The offering is described as licensing a core dataset to help users deliver models, forecasts and trend reports; it does not clearly say whether these outputs are provided by the offering or made by customers using the data. No AI model is stated, so non-AI is best-supported but forced and weak.
evidence_spans: allows you to license large portions of our core data set
to help you deliver more accurate models, forecasts and trend reports
conflict_response: The grammatical emphasis is on licensing a dataset, while models and forecasts are purposes it helps the user deliver; the text does not establish that a model/forecast engine is itself supplied. Nor does it identify the models as AI. This ambiguity warrants a weak forced non-AI label, not a supported negative.
